summary: Release v0.7.0 Adaptive Assurance Runtime with trigger-gated deliberation, evidence-backed assurance, bounded escalation, cache reuse, and CLI integration.

candidates.rationale: Add the constitutional adaptive-assurance contract and explicit semantic/deterministic boundary.
Add machine-readable assurance states, deliberation levels, risk floors, trigger policy, budgets, cache rules, actions, and privacy guard.
Add deterministic trigger/evaluation, epistemic-delta validation, bounded routing, and confined ephemeral cache mechanics.
Add executable coverage for assurance routing, evidence provenance, budgets, cache invalidation/confinement, manual modes, and Windows BOM JSON input.
Integrate assurance into authority/routing, full-regression impact signaling, root CLI dispatch, tool documentation, and integration tests without granting run-mutation authority.
Promote the workspace identity to v0.7.0 Adaptive Assurance Runtime and align release/context regression expectations.

applied_changes.description: Added assurance policy with explicit floors, triggers, budgets, cache, actions, and non-authoritative self-confidence.
Added assurance controller and CLI surface.
Integrated assurance with current authority, context routing, impact classification, CLI, and documentation.
